issue: Partly RESOLVED, partly a new finding, on the euractiv.com 'request-for-allocation-of-new-capacity' citation. Live URL kept, nothing dropped. NEW FINDING: the article's only capacity figure is a regasification throughput of '338.000 m3/hour', which is NOT either value the cells assert. 338,000 m3/h annualises to roughly 2.96 bcm/y, whereas this one URL is cited for Capacity=2.60 bcm/y on Unit 1 AND Capacity=0.30 bcm/y on the '2022 Capacity Expansion' unit-row -- i.e. GEM's 2.60 + 0.30 = 2.90 split is a derivation from the article's single hourly figure, not a value stated in it. Under the rule that a citation must explicitly contain the value it supports, both cells are currently implied-only. Separately, the same URL is cited on the expansion row's StartDate [ref] while both StartDate and StartYear are empty -- an orphan ref supporting no value (Unit 1's StartDate [ref] is likewise orphaned, citing the GIIGNL 2026 report with StartYear blank, and Krk has been operating since 2021).
suggested_action: Re-cite Capacity on both unit-rows from a source that states the bcm/y figures directly -- LNG Croatia's own capacity pages (lng.hr) or HERA/Plinacro regulatory filings -- and record the m3/h-to-bcm/y basis in ResearcherNotes so the 2.60/0.30 split is auditable. issue: RESOLVED -- the qc_tooling_bug flag raised earlier in this batch is fixed. citation_qc.py split ref cells on commas, but the comma is both the cell's list separator AND a legal URL character, so lngworldshipping.com/news/view,croatia-considers-fsru-for-krk-lng-imports_42088.htm was truncated to '.../news/view' and graded 'ok'. scripts/citation_qc.py now splits on each http(s):// boundary instead (_extract_urls / _URL_START_RE) and its 7 tests pass. Sweep-wide impact: 264 ref cells tracker-wide were mis-extracted, 20 of them in this batch's 13 countries. The bug produced false PASSES only, so the QC memo's dead-citation counts are a floor, never an overstatement. The Croatia URL it hid is genuinely gone (domain lapsed to a parking page) and its ProposalDate [ref] cell has been repaired in this batch.
